focus_area: JobPolicy authorization gate for AiJobCriteriaController regenerate (authorize job, :update?) and show (authorize job, :show?) — SPEC §9 mid-QA auth change, commit 859c85ead. Verified real policy behavior for admin, non-admin hiring-team member, and outsider against a running RAILS_ENV=test app; also verified controller org-scoping prevents cross-org leak.

verification_evidence.controller_scoping: Both #show and #create wrap the lookup in exists(current_organization.jobs.where(id: params[:job_id]), 'no job found') and call authorize INSIDE that block, AFTER the org-scoped find. A cross-org job_id yields an empty relation -> 'no job found' rendered before authorize is ever reached; no cross-org record leaks and no authorize runs on an out-of-org Job.
verification_evidence.show_vs_update_equivalence_note: JobPolicy#show? (job_policy.rb:12-14) is NOT literally on_hiring_team?; it is (is_org_user? && current_organization_user.jobs.where(id: record.id).any?) || is_org_admin?. It differs from update?/on_hiring_team? only by an extra is_org_user? guard. That guard can only reject an org_interviewer on the hiring team, but HiringTeamMembership#check_organization_user_role forbids org_interviewer from being a hiring-team member (verified: 'Organization user cannot have an Interviewer role'). Therefore every real hiring-team member is org_user or above, is_org_user? is always satisfied, and show? is equivalent to update? for all reachable principals. No divergence, no gap.
